text:
mika (Partnerships): Quick shout : SpectralCore accepted our connector into their ISV listing and will ship Redwood as an optional addon for their managed clusters. Pilot kickoff next week! :tada:

diego (Sales): Awesome. Any initial numbers? ARR signal?

mika (Partnerships): Pilot is 3 months, 30 managed clusters, initial consumption-based terms. Opportunity to convert to Dedicated for large customers.

chen (Engineering): They asked for a small Helm snippet and an example values.yaml for the connector. Also confirm our recommended resource requests for the sidecar agent.

rachel (Marketing): Can we capture a 1-line partner quote during kickoff? We'll hold public assets until we see stable telemetry for 2 weeks.

tara (Partner Success): I'll run the onboarding and request SSO + service account docs. Please add their lead engineer @alex.spectral (external) to the private channel.

mika (Partnerships): Private channel created: `#spectralcore-integration`. Invited core team + external lead.

spectral-ci-bot: marketplace bundle build OK (2026-05-02T11:03:12Z) sha: a1b2c3d

diego (Sales): Marked CRM opp as "ISV Marketplace Pilot" and flagged for ARR expansion if clusters >50. Looping AE.

chen (Engineering): Minimal Helm example to share:
```
# Install connector (chart v0.3.0)
helm repo add redwood https://charts.redwood.ai
helm install redwood-connector redwood/connector --namespace redwood \n  --set connector.apiKey="<REDACTED>" \n  --set agent.resources.requests.cpu="250m" \n  --set agent.resources.requests.memory="256Mi"
```
Will also drop a values.yaml template in `#spectralcore-integration`.

rachel (Marketing): Drafting partner blurb. Suggested copy: "SpectralCore and Redwood Inference bring managed LLM serving to production clusters with a turnkey connector for secure, scalable inference." Feedback?

mika (Partnerships): Nice. Tiny edit: change "managed LLM serving" to "managed LLM inference". Otherwise 👍

alex.spectral (external): Thanks team — looking forward to the pilot. We'll run a small ESB test next week and aim to share metrics after week 1.

mika (Partnerships): Next steps: (1) chen: values.yaml + resource guidance by EOD, (2) tara: kickoff + capture quote during onboarding, (3) rachel: partner blurb draft in `#partner-content` by Tue. Great work everyone! :rocket:
